verdict.rationale: Reducto documents an official CLI at docs.reducto.ai/cli, and a probe confirmed the page exists. The CLI gives direct terminal access to parse, extract, split, classify, and edit, so it covers the product's core capabilities. Missing for 10: details on installation, authentication and output formats (e.g. JSON for agent piping), any AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features beyond the capability list, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works.
